name: InterzoneXXL
author: L'Cronx
summary: Valley Audio's Interzone synth voice from VCV Rack, played from MIDI in mono or up to 16-voice poly, on the module's own panel with its sliders, knobs and switches, every input jack patched to a built-in source (four Bogaudio LFOs, Tidal Modulator 2, Random Sampler, step and gate sequencers, an extra oscillator) on the MPC tempo, a brickwall limiter, Panic and 16 presets.
